name: ThermaSol Spectra 3-4 Person Outdoor Sauna Cabin
description: Description Featuring contemporary styling with sustainably sourced materials, the Spectra Sauna Cabin delivers a revitalizing sauna sessions 365 days a year. Highlighted by the eye-catching insulated tempered glass facade, the wall protects against UV rays and improves thermal efficiency all while sauna lovers enjoy a floor-to-ceiling view. The cabin's surrounding exterior is crafted from fluted Tyrol wood panels offering a unique textured grain framed from black aluminum. Engineered for year-round performance, the exterior is complete with Firestone EPDM roofing, built-in rainwater management, and robust climate ratings. Inside, the Spectra stays cozy and well insulated year-round with the superb STEICO multi-layer wood fiber insulation. Tyrol wood wall panels offer a distinct aesthetic contrast in comparison to the sleek thermo-aspen benches and backrests. Sit back and adjust the full-spectrum LED lighting using an independent control to personalize your serene sauna ambiance from recessed locations. Finally, with the press of a touchpad the Xenio CX45 digital control swiftly creates intense heat and restorative steam through the Harvia Virta electric sauna heater. Supported by a 1-year warranty, the ThermaSol Spectra outdoor sauna brings modern wellness and architectural elegance into perfect harmony. Features Pre-engineered cabin crafted from sustainably sourced materials blending beauty and practicality All-season weatherproofed performance with STEICO multi-layer wood fiber insulation, a Firestone EPDM roof, and integrated rainwater management Parsol argon insulated tempered glass with UV-protection for enhanced safety, thermal efficiency and privacy Harvia Virta electric sauna heater for powerful, evenly distributed heating performance Harvia Xenio sauna control touchpad to adjust time and temperature with repeat scheduling and WiFi connectivity through the MyHarvia App Full-spectrum recessed LED lighting with independent controls for a personalized ambiance Ideal for gardens, patios, and backyard wellness spaces Arrives fully assembled with pre-wired electrical for turnkey use Dimensions: 90"W (228.6 cm) x 82"D (208.3 cm) x 91"H (231.1 cm) Designed and crafted in the U.S.A. What's Included Pre-Assembled Sauna Cabin Harvia Virta 8kW Sauna Heater with Wi-Fi Harvia Xenio CX45 Digital Control with Wi-Fi Harvia AC3020 Sauna Stones (3) Temperature Sensor Headrest (2) Wood Platform MyHarvia App Installation Instructions Specifications Recommended capacity: 3-4 people Exterior (W × D × H): 90″ × 82″ × 91″ Heater: Harvia 8kW VIRTA Heater with Wi-Fi Sauna type: Traditional (Finnish) Installation: Outdoor, freestanding Lead time: Made to order, 12 weeks (plus 5–10 business days delivery) Shipping & Lead Time Freight is quoted separately for every order based on your delivery location and configuration. After you place your order, our team will contact you with your shipping quote before your build begins. Saunas are delivered fully assembled via flatbed trailer, and you'll be notified roughly two weeks before the scheduled delivery. A forklift or crane is required for placement, and a licensed electrician must connect the heater — manual offloading is not recommended. Documents Specification Sheet
